data.long_meaning: A brave and courageous person who is not afraid of challenges. The name Mubariz carries the meaning “Brave and courageous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mubariz usually hope their child will grow to embody brave and courageous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is blessed with bravery and strength.
data.etymology: Mubariz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave and courageous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mubariz total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: مبارز
in_arabic.long_meaning: مبارز هو الشخص الذي يقاتل بشجاعة وثبات، ويستمد هذا الاسم من الجذر العربي ب-ر-ز، والذي يعني القتال والشجاعة، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التراث الإسلامي لوصف الصحابة والمناضلين الذين قاتلوا من أجل الدين

in_urdu.name: مبارز
in_urdu.long_meaning: مبارز وہ شخص ہے جو بہادری سے لڑتا ہے اور اپنے مقصد کے لیے قائم رہتا ہے، یہ نام عربی جڑ ب-ر-ز سے ماخوذ ہے، جو لڑائی اور بہادری کی象征 ہے، اور یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم روایت میں مذہبی اور ثقافتی اہمیت کا حامل ہے

in_hindi.name: मुबारिज
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुबारिज वह व्यक्ति है जो साहस से लड़ता है और अपने उद्देश्य के लिए दृढ़ रहता है, यह नाम अरबी जड़ ب-ر-ز से लिया गया है, जो लड़ाई और साहस का प्रतीक है, और यह नाम भारतीय मुसलमान समुदाय में सांस्कृतिक और धार्मिक महत्व का वाहक है

in_pashto.name: مبارز
in_pashto.long_meaning: مبارز هغه شخص دی چې د شجاعۍ سره جنگېږي او د خپل هدف لپاره پایدار پاتی کیږي، دا نوم د عربي ریښ ب-ر-ز څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د جگړې او شجاعۍ نمائندګی کوي، او دا نوم په افغان/پښتنو دود کې دینی او کلتوري اهمیت لرونکی دی

in_english.name: Mubariz
in_english.long_meaning: Mubariz is one who fights with courage and perseverance, deriving from the Arabic root ب-ر-ز, symbolizing battle and bravery, and holding significant spiritual and cultural importance in Islamic tradition and across Muslim cultures

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mubariz" is an Arabic word that originated from the root word "Barizah" which means bravery, courage, and fearlessness. This name carries a rich cultural significance as it signifies strength and resilience. Mubariz individuals are known to stand up for their beliefs and values, and are often highly regarded in their communities for their bravery and determination. They are admired for their ability to face adversity with courage and to overcome challenges with grace and poise.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Mubariz" holds great significance as it reflects the inner courage and strength of a person's spirit. It implies that the individual possesses a deep inner confidence and belief in themselves, as well as in their connection to the divine. This courage and strength allows them to navigate the ups and downs of life with faith and resilience, and to remain steadfast in their commitment to their spiritual path. The name Mubariz encourages individuals to be fearless in their pursuit of truth and to stand up for their beliefs with conviction and grace.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Brave and courageous" symbolizes A brave and courageous person who is not afraid of challenges.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mubariz serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of brave and courageous.
